name: @ka/web-next
description: Kunnskapsassistenten's client, drawn from genki's UI blocks, served by apps/server.

scripts.tokens:build: designsystemet tokens create --config designsystemet.config.json && designsystemet tokens build -t ./.tokens/design-tokens -o ./.tokens/build && cp ./.tokens/build/digdir.css src/theme.css && rm -rf ./.tokens
scripts.tokens:verify: designsystemet tokens create --config designsystemet.config.json && designsystemet tokens build -t ./.tokens/design-tokens -o ./.tokens/build && diff -q ./.tokens/build/digdir.css src/theme.css && rm -rf ./.tokens && echo 'tokens:verify OK'
